msg: === phase 1: click 超級管理員 quick-fill ===

note: click 超級管理員 button to auto-fill Soybean/123456
expr: (() => { const btns = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')); const target = btns.find(b => b.innerText.trim().includes('超級管理員') || b.innerText.trim().includes('超级管理员')); if (!target) return JSON.stringify({err: 'btn not found', titles: btns.map(b => b.innerText.trim())}); target.click(); return JSON.stringify({ok: true, clicked: target.innerText.trim()}); })()

msg: === phase 2: inspect inputs to confirm filled ===
=== phase 3: click 確認 to submit login ===

expr: (() => { const btns = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')); const target = btns.find(b => { const t = b.innerText.trim(); return t === '確認' || t === '确认'; }); if (!target) return JSON.stringify({err: 'btn not found', titles: btns.map(b => b.innerText.trim())}); target.click(); return JSON.stringify({ok: true, clicked: target.innerText.trim()}); })()

JSON.stringify({url: location.href, title: document.title, lsKeys: Object.keys(localStorage), token: localStorage.getItem('SOY_token') || localStorage.getItem('SOY_TOKEN') || localStorage.getItem('token')})
